name: Handshake
summary: Flat die-cut handshake of two clasped hands with different sleeves and skin tones, for deals, teamwork and agreement.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 760 px wide at s = 1

params.name: skin
params.note: skin of the left hand: a SKIN name from the style (light, fair, tan, medium, brown, dark) or any hex

params.name: skin2
params.note: skin of the right hand: a SKIN name or any hex

params.name: anim
params.note: shake pumps up and down; bob gently lifts

params.name: popIn
params.note: springs in over the first 10 frames

author: krakujs
